# Prince Martin Books by Brandon Hale

> Boys will love the Prince Martin Epic illustrated chapter book series about Martin, the brave boy prince. Written by Brandon Hale and illustrated by Jason Zimdars.

Machine-readable catalog (titles, ISBNs, ages, retailer links): https://www.princemartin.com/books.json
Contact: info@princemartin.com
